target_customer: Shippers in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan who book trucking, and independent truck owners who take the loads
problem: Egypt's trucking market is fragmented, with 93 percent of 1.3 million trucks independently operated, so shippers lack reliable capacity and drivers lack steady loads. Trella matches the two online and handles tracking and payment.
business_model: marketplace take rate, Trella pays the carrier and invoices the shipper

founders.name: Omar Hagrass
founders.background_notes: Led the Uber Eats launch in EMEA and launched more than 50 cities, per the YC page.

founders.name: Muhammad El Garem
founders.background_notes: Named by Wamda and press profiles.

competitors.name: Trukto
competitors.what: Egypt's first technology enabled trucking marketplace, founded 2017
competitors.traction_then: Acquisition gave Trella more than 10,000 active carriers

technical_complexity.rationale: A two sided marketplace with GPS tracking, pricing and payments is standard engineering. The harder parts were onboarding thousands of independent drivers and payments handling.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity on both sides and carrier relationships build over time, and the 2019 acquisition of the main local rival Trukto removed a competitor. Regional rivals such as TruKKer existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed Trella. A Dubai rival TruKKer planned to expand to Egypt and is described as competing with Trella across markets, date unclear. Trella acquired Trukto in December 2019.

market_need_then: Egypt had a fragmented trucking market with mostly independent owners, and Trella's founders cited chaotic coordination. Maersk later became a shipper customer, which shows corporate demand.

identity.visual_style: Clean modern layouts with stats and product screenshots, English and Arabic
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, upbeat and direct, short punchy phrasing

branding.community_and_virality: Coverage in Arab News, FreightWaves and Wamda, and a Forbes Middle East list. Reports 30,000 carriers on the platform.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional press recognition and a distinctive name, but no evidence of mascot, merch or community rituals.

outcome_analysis: Trella started with a 600 thousand dollar pre-seed in 2019, bought its main local rival Trukto in December 2019 and expanded into Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. In June 2021 it closed a 42 million dollar package of 30 million equity led by Maersk Growth and Raed Ventures plus 12 million debt. It later added a reported 6 million dollar debt facility and now lists 30,000 carriers across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. It remains independent.
notes: Founded 2018 per Wamda and 2019 per YC and other sources.  Dealroom lists later investors, unverified. The 2021 package is called Series A by Techloy, Wamda calls it a round. The website lists Saudi Arabia and the UAE while the 2021 article lists Pakistan, so footprint changed. Name origin not found. Outcome search returned nothing relevant for 2025 and 2026. Audit 3 fix: added the October 2022 $6M ALMA debt facility (US DFC guarantee of $4.2M; Wamda, Mubasher, Disrupt Africa) and the bridge round reported 2023-06-14 by Enterprise (Avanz Capital invested $3.5M of an undisclosed total; amount left null, quasi-equity).
